findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: REPEAT- The PIC is the only employee present and is not a Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM). The PIC has their food handler certificate, but was educated that there always needs to be at least one CFPM in the facility during all hours of food preparation and serving. Ensure that there are enough Certified Food Protection Managers to cover all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: There was a mop bucket of used mop water next to the mop sink. CORRECTED- This was discussed with the PIC who was educated that the waste water needs to be dumped in the mop sink immediately after use, as this prevents pest harborage conditions. Ensure that waste water is dumped immediately after use.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The caulking at the handwashing sink to the right of the ovens is observed to be in disrepair. Discussed re-caulking this by next routine inspection. Ensure that all repairs are made to be smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: REPEAT- There was a container of food for an employee in the top of the cooler containing hot dogs to the left of the ovens. CORRECTED- The PIC removed the food from the cooler and was educated that the food needs to be in a bottom shelf in a bin labeled personal. Ensure that food intended for employees is kept separate from food for consumers to prevent contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: There was not a Certified Food Protection Manager on duty at the facility today. Ensure that there is always at least one CFPM on duty during all hours of operation. 

 (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The soda nozzles were observed to have an accumulation of residue on them. Ensure that all soda nozzles are frequently cleaned. Food contact surfaces should be cleaned to sight and touch. A follow up will be conducted on 8/21/24 to ensure that the soda nozzles have been cleaned. 

(A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: The sanitizer water (Quat) was observed to only be at a concentration of 100 ppm. The recommended concentration for Quaternary Ammonium is 200 to 400ppm. Ensure that sanitizer buckets and water are routinely tested and changed if the concentration is low. CORRECTED- The sanitizer water was remade and tested to be at a concentration of 400ppm. 

Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-307.11: FIRST REPEAT- Water bottles are observed to be stored outside of the facility. Storing water bottles outside does not protect them from contamination. Ensure cases of water bottles are stored inside the facility in a clean, dry location. 

FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301-3-306.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.19: The following freezers are observed to have a large accumulation of ice build up:

1. The Breakfast Freezer.
2. The Lunch Freezer. 

Ensure that the ice build up in these freezers is scraped off and the issue is repaired to allow the freezers to be smooth and easily cleanable. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The following areas were observed to be in need of a cleaning: 

1. The fans in the walk-in cooler. 
2. The counter behind the tea station. 
3. The floors underneath the soda syrups. 

Ensure that these physical facilities are cleaned and then maintained cleaned as often as necessary. Physical facilities should be cleaned as often as necessary to maintain them clean. 

 (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-403.11: There were chips and salsa that had been opened and eaten by an employee stored on top of food intended for the facility. Ensure that employee storage is located to avoid contamination to food intended for the facility. CORRECTED- The items were moved out of the fridge and into an area away from food intended for the facility. 

(A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use tobacco shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
Water bottles cases were observed stored outside near the wall of the establishment. This is not considered a clean, dry location for the water bottles. Ensure the water bottles are moved to a clean, dry location where they are protected from possible contamination.
3-305.11: (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The mop was stored inside the mop bucket with dirty mop water in the bucket. Ensure the mop is stored in a position that allows it to air dry properly and old mop water is discarded. The mop was moved and water was discarded during the inspection. 

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: 5-205.11: Observed hand washing sink next to office to be blocked by boxes.  Boxes were moved. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment: 4-202.16: Observed ice cream freezer to have a thick layer of frost on interior of freezer.  Defrost ice cream freezer. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text: 750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17  (Pf) Observed no date marking on whipped topping bag. Food shall be clearly marked, at the time the original container is opened in a food establishment and if the food is held for more than 24 hours, to indicate the date or day by which the food shall be consumed on the premises, sold, or discarded, when held at a temperature of 41 deg F or less for a maximum of 7 days (not exceeding a manufacturer's use-by date). Discussed applicable sections of 3-501.17 and reviewed HACCP concepts with person in charge. Reference 3-501.17.
